page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 64 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core without hyperthreading, ensuring dedicated and predictable compute performance.

The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer rates for network-dependent workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.16xlarge offers a high-density memory allocation relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads. However, the lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a tradeoff for applications requiring high-speed local caching or parallelized hardware acceleration. This configuration is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
